cohort: Women who died during or after pregnancy and underwent medico-legal autopsy at Dr. V. M. Government Medical College Solapur, Maharashtra, India from January 2014 to December 2016.
finding: The overall maternal mortality ratio (MMR) of the institution was 369, with 43.68% of deaths occurring within 1-5 days of delivery and 87.37% occurring during the third trimester; 55.33% of deaths were directly pregnancy-related, and 44.66% were pregnancy-associated.
